Recorded public Arcus REST responses (GET only, no auth), 2026-11-16, from https://api.arcus.xyz and
https://api.testnet.arcus.xyz. markets and prices are trimmed to a few markets; books, health and time are whole.
The testnet account, positions, orders and rate-limit files are reads of a public testnet leaderboard address
(paper trading); that address is replaced by a placeholder. See docs/research/arcus-api.md.
